subject: Request: one-off eval credit & 30-day window extension for ArcadiaCare
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ArcadiaCare — ask: one-off eval credits + 30-day window extension

Marissa / team,

Quick summary: ArcadiaCare (large regional health network) is in the middle of a live pilot focused on discharge-summary generation. Their legal/procurement team has delayed signature for the SOW by two weeks due to updated security questions and an internal budget freeze that will clear only if we provide them a little more runway.

Why this matters: the pilot is high-likelihood (they've benchmarked outputs vs. vendor X and performance/latency is good) and the opportunity could convert to a 250k ARR production contract if we keep momentum. They are asking for: (1) a one-off credit grant to cover the pilot run-through while procurement signs the SOW, and (2) a 30-day extension to our standard 14-day PLG evaluation window.

Specific ask to Deal Desk / Execs:
- One-off: 75,000 token-equivalent credits (non-recurring) to cover August pilot consumption.
- Extension: 30 calendar days from current PLG expiry (new expiry target: 2026-06-30).
- Conditions: require signed SOW and PO by 2026-06-25, and include a clause for conversion discount if contract executed within 60 days.

Attachments: ArcadiaCare_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (MAP), SOW_Draft_v2.pdf

Rationale + risks: procurement delay is the only blocker. We preserve unit economics by making this non-recurring and conditioned on PO. If we deny, we risk losing momentum and likely the deal.

I recommend exec sign-off on the one-off credit + extension with the conditions above.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior AE, Northeast
Redwood Inference

Rachel — looping in Aditya for exec approval and Jordan for deal context.

I agree with the logic and the non-recurring framing. A few additional datapoints for the approver:
- Expected pilot consumption: ~60–80k token-equivalent (we're asking 75k as buffer).
- Close plan: MAP attached — internal clinical pilot success metrics and expected go-live timeline (60–90 days after PO).
- Commercial signal: Director of Data Science (Elena) indicated conversion confidence if we can run a full evaluation against their production dumps.

If approved, I'll mark the credits in finance and trigger a one-time waiver note on the deal record.

Marissa
